environment: Disposable Linux ARM64 VM, 1 CPU, 2 GiB; six loopback voters in two independent groups on one host.
method: Native voter processes and actual lease-round on loopback; each group chose a lease held by k16 at epoch 2. Group A used the signed receipt job; group B used a different job. The actual jn-verify consumed a fixed public-test signed receipt through a substituted filesystem reader. A pre-change verifier was separately compiled as the control. Two of group A voters were terminated to test quorum loss.
observed: pre-change verifier returned job/confirmed for the different job lease
with one of three voters remaining verifier refused
limits: Only receipt file access is stubbed; network and quorum are real but all voters share one VM and use unauthenticated loopback. The verifier uses the draft FS2 voter initialization from PR 572, not proof of main-branch binary provenance. No real cell, bot, credential, production key, current lease freshness, Mac, multi-host failure domain or governor is qualified.
